events.title: Virtual Conference: Diabetes, Its Complications and Management
events.desc: An online academic program held in November 2022, with six talks on diabetes and its complications.
events.more: The talks covered gestational diabetes, the diabetic foot, respiratory infections, cardiac issues, a clinical perspective on Gen 2.0 basal insulin therapy, and painful diabetic neuropathy. Speakers included Dr Vartika Srivastava, Dr Badri Vishal, Dr Chandrashekhar, Dr Anup Banerjee, Dr Brijendra Kumar Srivastava, and Dr Bimal Nautiyal.

events.title: Metabolic Management Meet (MMM)
events.desc: An in-person academic meeting on metabolic management, held in Uttar Pradesh.
events.more: Over 200 physicians, diabetologists, endocrinologists and gynecologists attended this Metabolic Management Meet to gain the latest insights into metabolic medicine and diabetes.

events.title: Virtual Conference: Cardio-Renal-Metabolic Care in Type 2 Diabetes
events.desc: An online conference on type 2 diabetes and cardio-renal-metabolic care. It was held online because of COVID restrictions.
events.more: A day-long program of four seminars and two panel discussions. Topics included moving from diabetic care to metabolic care, the role of DPP-4 inhibitors in individual patients, holistic cardio-renal-metabolic care in type 2 diabetes, technology for starting insulin, glycaemic variability, and the use of DPP-4 inhibitors with basal insulin.

events.title: Rural Medical Camp: Detection of Diabetes, Its Complications and Management
events.desc: A medical camp for people living in rural areas.
events.more: The camp aimed to detect diabetes and its complications and teach management in rural communities where diabetes is rising quickly. People were screened and taught how to manage diabetes and look after themselves. Checks included foot examination, haemoglobin for anaemia, ECG, eye examination and HbA1c, alongside blood sugar and blood pressure. Diabetologists spoke on diabetic neuropathy, nephropathy, retinopathy, and heart and foot disease.

events.title: Diabetes Awareness Camp
events.desc: A free medical camp on diabetes and its complications was held for people in need in District Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh.
events.more: All services and investigations were free. Lectures educated visitors on diabetes, its complications and management, and on ways to prevent diabetes. About 500 people were expected to benefit.
